title: CodeContext
description: A retrieved chunk of source code relevant to a failure, produced by the Retrieval Engine.

chunk_id.description: Unique identifier for this code chunk (UUID).

file_path.description: Path to the file within the repository.

start_line.description: First line number of the chunk (1-indexed).

end_line.description: Last line number of the chunk (1-indexed).

symbol_name.description: Function, method, or class name this chunk represents, if applicable.

content.description: The actual source code text of the chunk.

relevance_score.description: Similarity/relevance score from the retrieval step (0-1).

git_last_modified.description: Last commit timestamp touching this chunk, if available.

git_last_author.description: Author of the last commit touching this chunk, if available.
